title: remove freeway debris at the source
lensAText: a sceptical game designer and QA lead. Look at every image the builder cites with the Read tool, then check it yourself in ONE short Playwright script on dist at 1280x720 Day and 844x390 (DPR 2) Night: FIRST the I-5 North at the Disney Way / Katella Ave exit (the owner's spot: nothing of any ramp, deck or wall may slant across, hang over or stand in the lanes there), then the I-5 North at 57,470 m, the CA-241 North at 30,875 m, the CA-241 North into the 91 West at s~39650-39800, the CA-55 North s25176 and the CA-73 South s455, from the seat, hood and chase, plus a 60 s autopilot drive on two carriageways. Nothing may stand, hang or show through in or over the travel lanes, and nothing new may stand on a shoulder where the base (8b13bf9) had open ground; compare with 8b13bf9 (build it in a temporary copy OUTSIDE the worktree if you need it) and with the live game c3962c5.
brief: THE OWNER (2026-10-20): "there seems to be debris in some parts of the freeway so lets fix that as well too". THE OWNER AGAIN (2026-11-09 ~12:20 PM PT), with a screenshot of the LIVE game (v14 = c3962c5, without this fix) at 1350x750 (lost in the machine reset; this is what it showed): "also fix all this freway debris": on the I-5 North at the Disney Way / Katella Ave exit in Anaheim (the GPS showed '0 ft KEEP RIGHT DISNEY WAY / KATELLA A...' and 'NEXT EXIT Ball Road / Harbor Boulevard'), on the route to Stoppage Time: large grey slabs of road deck slanting across and above the lanes and the shoulder at car height, a tan brick sound wall jutting in at an angle, ramp surfaces cutting through each other. That spot is the FIRST thing to fix: find it (the Go To route to Stoppage Time passes it), name every piece (which road or ramp, which mesh, why it is there), check whether this branch's fix already removes it, and remove ALL of it at the source if not; then look for the same thing at every interchange the owner drives (the I-5 North and South between the CA-91 and the CA-22, and the Go To routes to Stoppage Time and Lot 57) and fix each at its source. STATE: HEAD is the local WIP commit 8b13bf9 (base 022f988 on claude/always-on) plus the restored uncommitted edits of three repairs and an interrupted fourth. What the fix does: levelled road heights with a profile limit (src/game/world/Profile.ts), heights baked at build time by scripts/levels.mjs into src/data/oc-levels.json (a boot check compares), sign bridges moved to clear spots, barriers and crash cushions giving way only up to 2.5 m, crash cushions across dead ends, allocation-free road search; cut road surfaces cut along the other road's edge (cells()), vertical 'under' sides along cut edges (cutSides(), 0.3 m pieces) whose feet go through Roads.sideFoot(), paint dropped by the surface's own cut, the deck soffit only under what stays, and boot checks for structure in the travel lanes and open cut edges. The CA-241 North / 91 West yellow saw-tooth (terrain seen through a cut surface) is FIXED. The last review REJECTED two NEW structures the base 8b13bf9 does not have: (1) I-5 North ~57,482 m: the 'under' cut side of ramp 800 (chunk 14) sits 2.01-2.31 m over the I-5 North's left lane (d -9.15 to -6.24) with a ~2.4 m block beside the yellow line, reading as a beam over the lane; the lanes check misses it because sideFoot raises the foot to 2.01 m, just above the check's 2 m limit; root cause: ramp 800's own surface stops in mid-air ~2.3 m above the I-5's left lane; (2) CA-241 North 30,880-30,888 m: a new ~2.5 m wall on the left shoulder (d -4.72 to -5.03; lane edge -3.66), a cut side standing where the base has open shoulder and grass. FIX ALL at the source: nothing of any OTHER road (surface, side, soffit, deck, barrier, paint) may be between 0.05 m and 4.5 m above a carriageway's drawn travel lanes (sideFoot and the checks share that one rule); a ramp or road running over another road's lanes below clearance either follows that road down to merge at grade or is cut back to end before the lanes with its end closed (a side down to the ground or a barrier end, never floating); a cut side may only stand where it closes a visible gap down to ANOTHER ROAD'S PAVEMENT right below it, never as a free wall on a shoulder, terrain or grass (add a check for that). Non-blocking unless they get worse: the CA-55 North hump (gentler), the 241's lanes left out over the 91 West for ~44 m, ramp 970's 1.7 m hump. PROVE: npm run build; npx tsc --noEmit; the WHOLE suite (npm test, split into two or three runs by group); a Node scan of EVERY chunk with the new checks: 0 hits; pair sheets (base 8b13bf9 or the live c3962c5 on top, yours below; seat, hood, chase; 1280x720 Day and 844x390 Night) at the I-5 North Disney Way/Katella exit, the I-5 North 57,470 m, the CA-241 North 30,875 m, the CA-241 North into the 91 West s~39720, the CA-55 North s25176 and the CA-73 South s455, as tests/out/debris/pairs/*-r5.png; and an autopilot drive of the 20 carriageways end to end at Moderate traffic (largest vertical acceleration, any stop). Look at every frame.

commit.how: Confirm 'git rev-parse HEAD' starts with 8b13bf9 (the local WIP commit, never pushed) and 'git rev-parse origin/claude/fix-road' starts with 022f988; if either differs stop with done=false. Instead of adding a new progress entry, UPDATE the debris entry at the top of PROJECT_OC_PROGRESS.md that the WIP commit added: it now PASSED review; describe the fixes (incl. the I-5 Disney Way/Katella spot, the 4.5 m clearance rule, the ramp-end and shoulder fixes), the checks, the frame paths and the suite lines; drop any 'not accepted yet' wording. Then 'git reset --soft 022f988' (the WIP commit was never pushed) so the result is ONE commit directly on 022f988.
